original.Name: Load fingerprint catalog
original.Scrapling call: openpyxl / pandas read of footprint xlsx (not Scrapling)
original.Notes: Split Search String on OR. Lowercase tokens. Keep quoted phrases intact.

proposed_behavior: Compile an approved JSON/JSONL release; offline workbook/source adapters feed the same typed rules. No XLSX parsing on every page.
acceptance_focus: Missing 99_MASTER_ALL, ambiguous OR/guard text, duplicate IDs, unknown operators or incompatible versions are explicit import failures, not executable guesses.

original.Name: Normalize input URL
original.Exact selector / pattern: Add https:// if missing; strip fragment; keep path+query
original.Notes: If input is a bare host, set path to /.

proposed_behavior: Keep original URL and path/query; normalize scheme/host, IDNA and fragment; validate public destination and ports.
acceptance_focus: Reject userinfo tricks, private/link-local destinations, unsafe schemes and redirect escapes. Preserve meaningful path/query case.

original.Name: HTTP GET static HTML
original.Returns: Response: status, body, headers, cookies, history, encoding
original.Notes: Primary fetcher. Matches view-source / static-HTML fingerprints.

proposed_behavior: Scrapling HTTP is the default; attach attempt identity, policy and budget before each network request.
acceptance_focus: A 200 challenge, 304 without retained body, truncated response or transport error is not complete usable HTML. Count failed attempts and redirects.

original.Name: Blocked-host fallback
original.Notes: May invent JS-only tags. Never the default.

proposed_behavior: Retain the workbook ID as the browser-fallback command; record actual DynamicFetcher or approved StealthyFetcher strategy and reason.
acceptance_focus: 429 causes backoff, not stealth escalation. Empty shells may justify rendering. Do not cross authentication/access restrictions. Every navigation and subrequest is bounded.

original.Name: GET /sitemap.xml
original.Notes: Replaces CC sitemap index. Count <sitemap> and product/job <loc>.

proposed_behavior: Capture XML or retained non-success response; safely parse indexes/urlsets, deduplicate and limit child depth and entry counts.
acceptance_focus: Sitemap counts are declared URL counts, not verified products/jobs. Bound compressed/decompressed size and reject external entities and disallowed targets.

original.Name: GET /robots.txt
original.Notes: Only used to find more sitemaps. Do not parse crawl-delay as a fingerprint.

proposed_behavior: Consult cached or newly fetched robots policy before crawling target content; also extract Sitemap directives.
acceptance_focus: This deliberately supersedes the workbook's 'sitemaps only' use. Failed retrieval is handled by an explicit policy, never a business absence.

original.Name: Probe known paths
original.Scrapling call: Fetcher.get(origin + path) for each path in 08_TEMPLATE_PATHS
original.Returns: 200 pages go through EXTRACT_*; 404 recorded as path_missing
original.Notes: Do not wait for a homepage link. Booking/portal/financing often unlinked from nav.

proposed_behavior: Deduplicated, ranked same-host candidate probes using the supplied template slots; reserve requests before issuance.
acceptance_focus: A probe is fetched once and its body reused. 404 is scoped path evidence, not missing software. Record paths skipped by budget or policy.

original.Name: Collect same-host follow URLs
original.Returns: queue of same-host URLs scored by template keywords
original.Notes: Keep only same host. Score paths containing book|schedule|contact|financ|portal|login|job|member|wholesale|inventory|pricing|demo.

proposed_behavior: Rank same-host links using all workbook slots; preserve deep input seed and separately consider home.
acceptance_focus: External ATS/portal links are retained as evidence but require a separately approved source scope before following.

original.Name: Canonical + redirect host
original.Notes: Fingerprint the final host, not the input redirector.

proposed_behavior: Record input, requested and final URLs, validated redirect chain, canonical claims and subject binding separately.
acceptance_focus: A canonical tag alone cannot merge organizations or extend crawl scope. Exact accepted host scope is distinct from registrable-domain grouping.

original.Name: Full source haystack
original.Notes: Primary haystack. Required for data-* attributes and inline snippets.

proposed_behavior: Retain original captured bytes in permitted storage; create a separate normalized match view with encoding and truncation metadata.
acceptance_focus: Do not overwrite source bytes with lowercase/errors=ignore. Raw/comment matches alone cannot prove active deployment.

original.Name: External script hosts
original.Returns: list of absolute script URLs + registrable hosts
original.Notes: Highest-yield command. CallRail, HubSpot, Klaviyo, Schedule Engine, Shopify, Stripe, Intercom, Chili Piper.

proposed_behavior: Extract per-element script URLs, parsed hosts and paths with precise evidence locators.
acceptance_focus: A script from an agency example or unbound frame must not become the site's product deployment.

original.Name: Inline script text
original.Notes: Catches copied widget snippets, Magento_ namespaces, NexHealth paste, data-api-key Schedule Engine bootstraps.

proposed_behavior: Preserve scoped inline-script text and stable declared globals; never execute it in the static path.
acceptance_focus: Keep values carrying keys/tokens out of routine exports; arbitrary 'AI' or library text is not product proof.

original.Name: Iframes / embeds
original.Notes: Boulevard, Jane, Vetstoria, Clio Grow, Lawmatics, GemFind, hotel booking engines, ATS job boards.

proposed_behavior: Retain iframe, embed and object URLs with embedding-page and frame attribution.
acceptance_focus: Capture reference does not authorize external/private portal navigation; do not combine different tenant frames.

original.Name: Form endpoints
original.Notes: Intake CRMs, LawPay pay-now, HubSpot forms that post to hsforms.

proposed_behavior: Read form action, method and relevant attributes as metadata without submitting.
acceptance_focus: No form submissions. An action/reference is not a verified backend CRM connection.

original.Name: Outbound + internal links
original.Returns: abs URLs split into same_host[] and outbound_hosts[]
original.Notes: LawPay, Allē, ASPIRE, GIA reportcheck, AAML/AILA, patient portals, CareCredit apply.

proposed_behavior: Retain node-level href, text, role and same-host/outbound classification.
acceptance_focus: Keep anchor evidence distinct from loaded scripts. Mention, login link, appointment CTA and publisher credit require different mappings.

original.Name: Badge images + alt text
original.Notes: Invisalign Provider, Super Lawyers, Avvo, Allergan/Galderma Elite, Rolex Official Retailer.

proposed_behavior: Read each image's src/alt together; retain badge claim and element context.
acceptance_focus: A displayed badge is a website assertion, not independent accreditation. Do not pair separate truncated src/alt arrays.

original.Name: link + meta tags
original.Notes: Shopify meta name=shopify-digital-wallet. og:url often still has myshopify.com.

proposed_behavior: Read per-node link and meta attribute tuples, preserving duplicates and provenance.
acceptance_focus: Do not independently zip name/content arrays or collapse conflicting meta values without a record.

original.Name: JSON-LD blocks
original.Returns: list of objects; flatten @type (string or list) into schema_types[]
original.Notes: Product, JobPosting, LegalService, Hotel, LodgingBusiness, Dentist, MedicalClinic, Physician, Car, DietarySupplement.

proposed_behavior: Retain every bounded raw block plus parsed object/array/@graph, local subject references and parse errors.
acceptance_focus: Malformed blocks are not silently absent. Parsed graph identity must be retained; regex hints cannot stand in for a successful parse.

original.Name: Microdata itemtype
original.Notes: Fallback when JSON-LD is missing but itemtype='https://schema.org/Dentist' exists.

proposed_behavior: Read itemtype and typeof with item scope and parent/node identity.
acceptance_focus: A type belonging to an embedded article or third party is not the site's organization classification.

original.Name: Footer credit strip
original.Notes: Sesame / PBHS / Officite / ProSites / Clubessential / Powered by LawPay / DSO copyright.

proposed_behavior: Extract and deduplicate footer/copyright nodes with text, HTML and role attribution.
acceptance_focus: A 'powered by' or agency link may identify a site provider, not software owned or used internally by the prospect.

original.Name: Header + nav CTAs
original.Exact selector / pattern: header, nav, a:contains-ish via href keywords
original.Notes: Finds booking/portal even when they are buttons rather than iframes.

proposed_behavior: Preserve header/nav and CTA nodes with URL, text, element and role.
acceptance_focus: Use approved public interactions only for rendered controls; no login, booking, payment or other state-changing action.

original.Name: data-* vendor markers
original.Notes: CallRail noswap, Schedule Engine embed id, Shopify wallet meta.

proposed_behavior: Use parsed attributes first, with bounded regex only as raw candidate discovery.
acceptance_focus: Whitespace, quoting and case fixtures; fake attribute text in comments/prose does not qualify as a real node.

original.Name: noscript fallback HTML
original.Returns: extra HTML often containing iframe pixels
original.Notes: Some review/chat vendors leave a noscript iframe.

proposed_behavior: Retain nested fallback markup with an explicit noscript scope and original locator.
acceptance_focus: Fallback code is not evidence that a request executed in the rendered session.

original.Name: Prose haystack (secondary)
original.Notes: Use ONLY for prose fingerprints (iTero, flat fee divorce, Allē Rewards, initiation fee). Never as the only haystack.

proposed_behavior: Use a text view excluding scripts/styles and mark static DOM text separately from browser-visible text.
acceptance_focus: For prose rules only; not the sole technology surface. Do not label regex tag stripping as true browser visibility.

original.Name: Path + query features
original.Notes: /products /jobs /members /wholesale /inventory /pricing /security /case-studies /quick-order; query color|size|page.

proposed_behavior: Parse path, query keys and relevant discovered link features; retain resource identity.
acceptance_focus: Query values containing personal data or secrets are restricted/redacted; /jobs is a path, not a job count.

original.Name: HTTP headers + cookies
original.Notes: Only Magento Mage-Cache-SessId and similar. Do not require this for other rows.

proposed_behavior: Preserve status and safe header pairs, repeated headers and cookie names for each response; a host summary can reuse them.
acceptance_focus: Transport observations must retain response provenance. Cookie values and secrets are not normal fingerprint exports.

original.Name: Case-insensitive contains
original.Notes: Default matcher for vendor hosts: cdn.callrail.com, js.hs-scripts.com, joinblvd.com.

proposed_behavior: Case policy is explicit; match an allowed, bounded surface item and record the actual token/location.
acceptance_focus: No generic raw substring shortcut for hostname authority; case-sensitive paths/IDs remain case-sensitive when required.

original.Name: Any token of an OR row
original.Scrapling call: any(tok in hay for tok in tokens)
original.Notes: Row hits if ANY alternative token hits.

proposed_behavior: Evaluate typed ANY alternatives while retaining original row semantics, matched branch and evidence.
acceptance_focus: Do not split quoted phrases or arbitrary natural-language guards on every occurrence of OR.

original.Name: Structured regex
original.Notes: Use for JSON-LD types and data-* markers, not for vendor names.

proposed_behavior: Run compiled, allowlisted, resource-bounded patterns over their declared surfaces.
acceptance_focus: Prefer parsed JSON-LD and attributes. Regex compilation alone is not timeout/cost safety.

original.Name: URL host equals vendor
original.Notes: Prevents 'notcallrail.com' false prefix hits. Prefer this over raw substring for hosts.

proposed_behavior: Parse actual hostname; exact equality or dot-delimited suffix against the declared hostname; use PSL only for separate normalization.
acceptance_focus: Reject notvendor.com, vendor.com.evil, vendor in path/query, and vendor.com@evil. Do not collapse a specific cdn hostname to its parent.

original.Name: Footer phrase
original.Exact selector / pattern: Powered by Sesame Communications | Powered by Clubessential | Powered by LawPay
original.Notes: Search footer bags first; fall back to hay_raw.

proposed_behavior: Match the actual footer region first. Raw fallback produces a lower-authority mention candidate unless region binding is established.
acceptance_focus: Do not automatically turn footer provider credits into prospect product-use facts.

original.Name: Badge alt / nearby text
original.Scrapling call: any(needle in alt.lower() for alt in img_alts) or needle in hay_raw
original.Exact selector / pattern: Invisalign Provider | Super Lawyers | Official Rolex Retailer
original.Notes: Alt first, then raw HTML for CSS background badges with no alt.

proposed_behavior: Match image alt or a verified element-local badge context.
acceptance_focus: Whole-page raw fallback is candidate evidence only. Displayed credential is not credential verification.

original.Name: False-positive AND-term
original.Scrapling call: if and_terms: any(t in host_hay_raw or host_hay_text for t in and_terms) else True
original.Notes: CallRail without divorce|custody|family law is not Family Law. Skip gate when catalog says none needed.

proposed_behavior: Evaluate compiled guard conditions over same-subject, same-run host evidence; retain all contributing locators.
acceptance_focus: The workbook's named AND gate uses ANY among listed OR terms. Do not suppress a valid generic vendor observation when vertical qualification fails.

original.Name: Vertical schema confirm
original.Returns: schema_ok bool or None if no schema present
original.Notes: Absence of schema is NOT a fail. Presence of the wrong type is a warning.

proposed_behavior: Evaluate relevant bound schema types as contextual support, with missing/contradictory/ambiguous outcomes.
acceptance_focus: No schema is not a failure; wrong or unbound type is a warning/confound, not an automatic negative.

original.Name: Deprioritize filters
original.Exact selector / pattern: synxis.com, golfnow.com, teeoff.com, hilton.com/book, marriott.com/reservation, national DSO names
original.Notes: Keep evidence; drop outbound priority.

proposed_behavior: Apply a versioned commercial-deprioritization policy while preserving every underlying match.
acceptance_focus: Commercial negatives neither retract facts nor count as operational DNC restrictions.

original.Name: Union page bags
original.Scrapling call: set unions across pages of host
original.Returns: host record with unique script_hosts, iframe_hosts, outbound_hosts, schema_types, paths, footer
original.Notes: Matching is host-level, not page-level, except for recording page_found_on.

proposed_behavior: Accumulate a provenance-preserving host index before gates; finalize the same index after all pages/commands terminate.
acceptance_focus: Do not concatenate into anonymous strings, cross host/subject scope, or discard duplicate rule supports. Two modes avoid the workbook ordering ambiguity.

original.Name: Priority score
original.Exact selector / pattern: exclusive vendor + and_term_ok = high; generic pixel only = medium; negative = low
original.Notes: Use catalog Priority for outbound as the base weight.

proposed_behavior: Compute an explainable, versioned scan/commercial priority separate from detection confidence and fact authority.
acceptance_focus: The workbook does not specify numerical weights. Mark proposed weights uncalibrated; never use score to promote a candidate fact.

original.Name: Write result
original.Returns: One row per host, plus one row per hit
original.Notes: Persist pages_fetched and js_rendered so Verified vs Likely can be audited.

proposed_behavior: Write versioned ScanBundle with attempts, artifacts, coverage, surface index, matches, qualifiers, score and per-command outcomes; retain legacy host/hit projections.
acceptance_focus: No-hit, incomplete and failed states remain distinct; write atomically/idempotently. HostResult alone cannot serve as the fact evidence store.
